subtopics.name: Points & Lines
subtopics.description: Points serve as the fundamental anchors of visual space, while lines define contours, movement, and boundaries, forming the primary skeletal framework of any visual art piece.

subtopics.name: Formal Structures
subtopics.description: Understanding geometric frameworks and underlying shapes that allow artists to break down complex organic forms into manageable, structurally sound proportions.

subtopics.name: Volume
subtopics.description: The illusion of mass and three-dimensional depth on a flat surface, achieved through careful manipulation of contours, shading, and spatial awareness.

subtopics.name: Chiaroscuro: Tone & Light/Shadow
subtopics.description: The artistic contrast between light and dark that creates dramatic focal points, volume, and emotional depth within a drawing or painting.

subtopics.name: The Color Wheel
subtopics.description: A visual organizational chart of primary, secondary, and tertiary colors that guides harmonious palettes and color mixing decisions.

subtopics.name: Value Relationships
subtopics.description: The relative lightness or darkness of a color, which dictates contrast, readability, and structural form independent of hue.

subtopics.name: Temperature
subtopics.description: The emotional and visual division of colors into warm (reds, yellows) and cool (blues, greens) spectrums to create atmospheric depth.

subtopics.name: Harmonization
subtopics.description: The art of combining colors in pleasing, balanced relationships that evoke specific moods and aesthetic coherence.

subtopics.name: Linear Perspective
subtopics.description: A mathematical and visual system using horizon lines and vanishing points to render realistic depth and spatial recession on a two-dimensional plane.

subtopics.name: Focal Points
subtopics.description: Strategic placement and contrast of elements that naturally direct the viewer's eye to the most important part of the artwork.

subtopics.name: Spatial Tension
subtopics.description: The dynamic interplay and psychological push-and-pull between shapes, negative space, and compositional boundaries.

subtopics.name: Framing
subtopics.description: Using environmental or structural elements within the artwork to enclose and emphasize the primary subject matter.

subtopics.name: Proportions
subtopics.description: The precise mathematical and comparative relationship between different parts of the human body to achieve realistic anatomical harmony.

subtopics.name: Skeletal Structure
subtopics.description: The underlying bony landmarks that provide posture, rigidity, and the true framework for human form and movement.

subtopics.name: Muscle Landmarks
subtopics.description: The surface anatomy of muscular groups that flex, stretch, and define the dynamic contours of the human body under various lighting conditions.

subtopics.name: Gestural Sketching
subtopics.description: Rapid, expressive line work capturing the core energy, movement, and life posture of a living subject in seconds.

subtopics.name: Canon of Proportions
subtopics.description: The sacred, traditional geometric rules governing the spiritual depiction of faces, eyes, and figures in Ethiopian Orthodox sacred art.

subtopics.name: Traditional Pigments & Preparation
subtopics.description: The ancient methods of extracting natural earth and plant pigments, preparing wooden panels, and binding colors for lasting preservation.

subtopics.name: Spiritual & Symbolic Geometry
subtopics.description: The underlying mathematical patterns, halos, and structural layouts that convey deep theological meanings and reverence.

subtopics.name: Halo & Lineament Drafting
subtopics.description: The precise techniques of drawing radiant halos and delicate facial features that define the character and holiness of traditional icons.
